Frequently asked questions
How do I redeem a voucher?
›
Tap "My Vouchers" in your profile, then tap any active voucher to show the QR code. Present this to staff at the venue — they will scan it to redeem your deal.
Can I get a refund on a voucher?
›
Vouchers can be refunded up to 2 hours before the happy hour starts. After that, the voucher is non-refundable. Contact support to request a refund.
Why wasn't my community deal approved?
›
Community deals are reviewed before going live. Deals must include a real venue, accurate pricing, and a valid time window. Spam or inaccurate posts are removed.
How do credits work?
›
You earn credits by buying vouchers, redeeming deals, posting tips, and inviting friends. Credits can be redeemed for free drinks, skip-the-queue passes, and more.
How do I report an incorrect deal?
›
On any deal detail page, scroll down and tap "Report deal". Our team reviews all reports within 24 hours.
Still need help?
Our support team is available Mon–Fri, 9am–8pm

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences and understand how you use our app. We also use similar technologies like pixels and web beacons.

How We Use Cookies

We use cookies to provide core functionality, analyze how our app is used, remember your preferences, and deliver personalized content and advertisements.

📆 Vouchers per date
Dates come from your Start–End dates & valid days. Time is optional — leave it empty and guests can arrive any time in the happy-hour window. Leave vouchers empty (or 0) to close a date.
⏱️ Redemption Window
Vouchers can only be scanned during your happy-hour times — scans before or after are rejected
e.g. with a 15-min grace on a 5PM–9PM deal, scans are accepted 4:45PM–9:15PM.
